measurement_notes: All initial and follow-up samples are retained. Final timing comparisons pool every available matched pair for each workload/reference; no observations are removed.
Follow-ups use the same CPU and benchmark protocols. The host is busy; CPU time also varies with contention. Approximate bootstrap intervals are diagnostics, not a universal guarantee.
The six existing runtime workload binaries match the preceding stage after equal-width toolchain path normalization. Only the new match_dispatch workload changes.
The 250k fresh root lines/s and universal C/Rust runtime targets remain unmet. Absolute rates across changing host loads are not a compiler speedup.
